# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}

Get details of a specific organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** optional (affects email visibility) · **ID:** `ep-031`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
